description: Erection of an extension at second floor level, additional stairwell extension at third storey level to facilitate access to proposed roof terrace with associated glazed balustrade
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed roof terrace, by reason of its inappropriate location, scale and detailed design, would result in unacceptable levels of noise, disturbance and overlooking, to the detriment of the living conditions of adjoining residential occupiers. Therefore, it is considered that the proposed development fails to comply with the requirements set out in policy LP2 (Development and Amenity), policy LP58 (Improving the Environment - Pollution) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and Policy D14 (Noise) of The London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; text-align: justify; white-space-collapse: preserve;">The proposed </span><span id="docs-internal-guid-bd35035a-7fff-0167-7776-362a842c8845"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">third floor stairwell extension and associated balustrade</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; text-align: justify; white-space-collapse: preserve;">, by reason of its unsympathetic scale, form, siting and design, would comprise an incongruous, discordant and overly prominent form of development, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the site, neighbouring properties and the wider local area. It is considered that the proposal would be contrary to Policies D1 (London’s form, character and capacity for growth) and D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) The London Plan (2021), as well as Policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 and the Council’s REA SPD (2009). </span></p>
